When we deceive or overcome our neighbour, have we deceived or overcome all the forces of justice?

60212-the-physical-basis-of-mind-being-t.title: Problems Of Life And Mind.
60212-the-physical-basis-of-mind-being-t.creator: George Henry Lewes.
60212-the-physical-basis-of-mind-being-t.description: A book by George Henry Lewes.. The Human Mind, so far as it is accessible to scientific inquiry, has a twofold root, man being not only an animal organism but an unit in the social organism; and hence the complete theory of its functions and faculties must be sought in this twofold direction.

arxiv-2104-10676.title: An Analytic Hybrid Halo + Perturbation Theory Model for Small-scale Correlators: Baryons, Halos, and Galaxies
arxiv-2104-10676.creator: Sukhdeep Singh
arxiv-2104-10676.description: Abstract We update Halo Zeldovich Perturbation Theory (HZPT, [ 1 ] ), an analytic model for the two-point statistics of dark matter, to describe halo and galaxy clustering, and galaxy-matter cross-correlation on nonlinear scales. The model correcting Zeldovich has an analytic Fourier transform, and therefore is valid in both configuration space and Fourier space.

arxiv-2107-00357.title: Prophet Inequality with Competing Agents
arxiv-2107-00357.creator: Tomer Ezra, Michal Feldman, Ron Kupfer
arxiv-2107-00357.description: Abstract We introduce a model of competing agents in a prophet setting, where rewards arrive online, and decisions are made immediately and irrevocably. The rewards are unknown from the outset, but they are drawn from a known probability distribution. In the standard prophet setting, a single agent makes selection decisions in an attempt to maximize her expected reward.

arxiv-2110-15232.title: Guided Evolution for Neural Architecture Search
arxiv-2110-15232.creator: Vasco Lopes, Miguel Santos, Bruno Degardin, Luís A. Alexandre
arxiv-2110-15232.description: Abstract Neural Architecture Search (NAS) methods have been successfully applied to image tasks with excellent results. However, NAS methods are often complex and tend to converge to local minima as soon as generated architectures seem to yield good results. In this paper, we propose G-EA, a novel approach for guided evolutionary NAS.

arxiv-2303-05785.title: Scaling Up 3D Kernels with Bayesian Frequency Re-parameterization for Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2303-05785.creator: Ho Hin Lee, Quan Liu, Shunxing Bao, Qi Yang, Xin Yu, Leon Y. Cai, Thomas Li, Yuankai Huo, Xenofon Koutsoukos, Bennett A. Landman
arxiv-2303-05785.description: Abstract With the inspiration of vision transformers, the concept of depth-wise convolution revisits to provide a large Effective Receptive Field (ERF) using Large Kernel (LK) sizes for medical image segmentation. However, the segmentation performance might be saturated and even degraded as the kernel sizes scaled up (e.g.

arxiv-2305-13384.title: Toward a search for axion-like particles at the LNLS
arxiv-2305-13384.creator: L. Angel 1,2, P. Arias 3, C. O. Dib 4, A. S. de Jesus 1,2, S. Kuleshov 5,6, V. Kozhuharov 7, L. Lin 8, M. Lindner 9, F. S. Queiroz 1,2,6, R. C. Silva 1,2, Y. Villamizar 10
arxiv-2305-13384.description: Abstract Axion-Like Particles (ALPs) appear in several dark sector studies. They have gained increasing attention from the theoretical and experimental community. In this work, we propose the first search for ALPs to be conducted at the Brazilian Synchrotron Light Laboratory (LNLS).

arxiv-2305-18110.title: State preparation in quantum algorithms for fragment-based quantum chemistry
arxiv-2305-18110.creator: Ruhee D’Cunha, Matthew Otten, Matthew R. Hermes, Laura Gagliardi, Stephen K. Gray
arxiv-2305-18110.description: Abstract State preparation for quantum algorithms is crucial for achieving high accuracy in quantum chemistry and competing with classical algorithms. The localized active space unitary coupled cluster (LAS-UCC) algorithm iteratively loads a fragment-based multireference wave function onto a quantum computer. In this study, we compare two state preparation methods, quantum phase estimation (QPE) and direct initialization (DI), for each fragment.

arxiv-2309-04289.title: Programmable Real-Time Magnon Interference in Two Remotely Coupled Magnonic Resonators
arxiv-2309-04289.creator: Moojune Song, Tomas Polakovic, Jinho Lim, Thomas W. Cecil, John Pearson, Ralu Divan, Wai-Kwong Kwok, Ulrich Welp, Axel Hoffmann, Kab-Jin Kim, Valentine Novosad, Yi Li
arxiv-2309-04289.description: Abstract Magnon interference is a signature of coherent magnon interactions for coherent information processing. In this work, we demonstrate programmable real-time magnon interference, with examples of nearly perfect constructive and destructive interference, between two remotely coupled yttrium iron garnet spheres mediated by a coplanar superconducting resonator.

arxiv-2404-07134.title: Investigating Ocean Circulation Dynamics Through Data Assimilation: A Mathematical Study Using the Stommel Box Model with Rapid Oscillatory ·orcings
arxiv-2404-07134.creator: Nathaniel Smith, Anvaya Shiney-Ajay, Emmanuel ·leurantin, Ivo Pasmans
arxiv-2404-07134.description: Abstract We investigate ocean circulation changes through the lens of data assimilation using a reduced-order model. Our primary interest lies in the Stommel box model which reveals itself to be one of the most practicable models that has the ability of reproducing the meridional overturning circulation.

arxiv-2407-08653.title: An infrared census of R Coronae Borealis Stars II – Spectroscopic classifications and implications for the rate of low-mass white dwarf mergers
arxiv-2407-08653.creator: Viraj R. Karambelkar, Mansi M. Kasliwal, Patrick Tisserand, Shreya Anand, Michael C. B. Ashley, Lars Bildsten, Geoffrey C. Clayton, Courtney C. Crawford, Kishalay De, Nicholas Earley, Matthew J. Hankins, Xander Hall, Astrid Lamberts, Ryan M. Lau, Dan McKenna, Anna Moore, Eran O. Ofek, Roger M. Smith
arxiv-2407-08653.description: Abstract We present results from a systematic infrared (IR) census of R Coronae Borealis (RCB) stars in the Milky Way, using data from the Palomar Gattini IR (PGIR) survey. R Coronae Borealis stars are dusty, erratic variable stars presumably formed from the merger of a He-core and a CO-core white dwarf (WD).

arxiv-2507-15575.title: Accelerating Universe without dark energy: matter creation after DESI DR2
arxiv-2507-15575.creator: Sauvik Bhattacharjee, Sudip Halder, Jaume de Haro, Supriya Pan, Emmanuel N. Saridakis
arxiv-2507-15575.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sauvik Bhattacharjee, Sudip Halder, Jaume de Haro, Supriya Pan, Emmanuel N. Saridakis. We investigate the cosmological matter creation scenario, an alternative approach to both dark energy and modified gravity theories, after the recent DESI DR2-BAO release. We consider that the total matter sector consists of three independently evolving components, namely, radiation, baryons, and dark matter, with the latter being governed by an adiabatic matter creation process that leads to a modified continuity equation.

arxiv-2508-14513.title: Dynamic Vacancy Levels in CsPbCl 3 \text{CsPbCl}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{3}}} Obey Equilibrium Defect Thermodynamics
arxiv-2508-14513.creator: Irea Mosquera-Lois, Aron Walsh
arxiv-2508-14513.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Irea Mosquera-Lois, Aron Walsh. Halide vacancies are the dominant point defects in perovskites with V ​ Cl {}_{\text{Cl}} identified as a detrimental trap for the optoelectronic performance of CsPbCl 3 \text{CsPbCl}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{3}}} , with applications ranging from photodetectors to solar cells. Understanding these defects under operating conditions is key since their electronic levels exhibit large thermal fluctuations that challenge the validity of static 0 K models.

arxiv-2510-02669.title: AutoMaAS: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Architecture Search for Large Language Models Thanks: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant 92270114.
arxiv-2510-02669.creator: 1 st Bo Ma 1, 2 nd Hang Li, 3 rd ZeHua Hu, 4 th XiaoFan Gui, 5 th LuYao Liu, 6 th Simon Lau
arxiv-2510-02669.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by 1 st Bo Ma 1, 2 nd Hang Li, 3 rd ZeHua Hu, 4 th XiaoFan Gui, 5 th LuYao Liu, 6 th Simon Lau. Multi-agent systems powered by large language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse domains, yet existing automated design approaches seek monolithic solutions that fail to adapt resource allocation based on query complexity and domain requirements.

arxiv-2512-14273.title: Zoom-Zero: Reinforced Coarse-to-Fine Video Understanding via Temporal Zoom-in
arxiv-2512-14273.creator: Xiaoqian Shen 1,2∗ Min-Hung Chen 1 Yu-Chiang Frank Wang 1 Mohamed Elhoseiny 2 Ryo Hachiuma 1 1 NVIDIA 2 KAUST
arxiv-2512-14273.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiaoqian Shen 1,2∗ Min-Hung Chen 1 Yu-Chiang Frank Wang 1 Mohamed Elhoseiny 2 Ryo Hachiuma 1 1 NVIDIA 2 KAUST. Grounded video question answering (GVQA) aims to localize relevant temporal segments in videos and generate accurate answers to a given question; however, large video-language models (LVLMs) exhibit limited temporal awareness. Although existing approaches based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) attempt to improve temporal grounding, they still struggle to faithfully ground their answers in the relevant video evidence, leading to temporal mislocalization and hallucinations.

arxiv-2512-20418.title: Divergence Method to Stability Study of Andronov-Vyshnegradsky Problem. Hidden Oscillations
arxiv-2512-20418.creator: I.B. Furtat, N.V. Kuznetsov
arxiv-2512-20418.description: Abstract The classical Andronov-Vyshnegradsky problem, which deals with locating regions of stability and oscillations in control systems with a Watt regulator, is solved using a divergence method for studying the stability of dynamic systems. This system is studied both with and without the self-regulation effect. The exact value of the hidden boundary of the global stability region is obtained.

pmc-10576335.title: Pax7 haploinsufficiency impairs muscle stem cell function in Cre-recombinase mice and underscores the importance of appropriate controls
pmc-10576335.creator: Despoina Mademtzoglou, Perla Geara, Philippos Mourikis, Frederic Relaix
pmc-10576335.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Ever since its introduction as a genetic tool, the Cre-lox system has been widely used for molecular genetic studies in vivo in the context of health and disease, as it allows time- and cell-specific gene modifications. However, insertion of the Cre-recombinase cassette in the gene of interest can alter transcription, protein expression, or function, either directly, by modifying the landscape of the locus, or indirectly, due to the lack of genetic compensation or by indirect impairment of the non-targeted allele.

pmc-10631160.title: Ultrasound-guided disc pain induction test for diagnosis of discogenic lumbar pain: a cross-sectional study
pmc-10631160.creator: Keisuke Masuda, Hideki Shigematsu, Manabu Maeda, Akinori Okuda, Yasuhito Tanaka
pmc-10631160.description: BackgroundSeveral methods can be used to diagnose discogenic pain, but only discoblock can diagnose discogenic pain definitively. This study aimed to examine the usefulness of an ultrasound-guided disc pain induction test for a simple and accurate diagnosis of the culprit lesion.MethodsWe included 41 patients with lumbar pain in whom pain was induced by an ultrasound-guided disc pain induction test.

pmc-10636046.title: Artificial axons as a biomimetic 3D myelination platform for the discovery and validation of promyelinating compounds
pmc-10636046.creator: Anna Jagielska, Kristin Radzwill, Daniela Espinosa-Hoyos, Mingyu Yang, Kavin Kowsari, Jonathan E. Farley, Stefanie Giera, Ann Byrne, Guoqing Sheng, Nicholas X. Fang, James C. Dodge, Carlos E. Pedraza, Krystyn J. Van Vliet
pmc-10636046.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Multiple sclerosis (MS), a chronic neurodegenerative disease driven by damage to the protective myelin sheath, is currently incurable. Today, all clinically available treatments modulate the immune-mediated symptoms of the disease but they fail to stop neurodegeneration in many patients. Remyelination, the regenerative process of myelin repair by oligodendrocytes, which is considered a necessary step to protect demyelinated axons and stop neuronal death, is impaired in MS patients.

pmc-10679887.title: Effective Communication About Lung Cancer Screening Without Iatrogenic Stigma: A Brief Report Case Study Using the Lung Cancer Stigma Communications Assessment Tool of LungTalk
pmc-10679887.creator: Lisa Carter-Bawa, Jamie S. Ostroff, Kaitlyn Hoover, Jamie L. Studts
pmc-10679887.description: IntroductionStigma thwarts progress in lung cancer risk reduction and control and adversely affects patients across the entire lung cancer care continuum. In developing and disseminating patient and public-facing interventions to increase lung screening, we must be cognizant of how communications have the potential for further stigmatization of at-risk populations.

pmc-11300593.title: Analysis of homodimer formation in 12-oxophytodienoate reductase 3 in solutio and crystallo challenges the physiological role of the dimer
pmc-11300593.creator: Bianca Kerschbaumer, Peter Macheroux, Aleksandar Bijelic
pmc-11300593.description: 12-oxophytodienoate reductase 3 (OPR3) is a key enzyme in the biosynthesis of jasmonoyl-L-isoleucine, the receptor-active form of jasmonic acid and crucial signaling molecule in plant defense. OPR3 was initially crystallized as a self-inhibitory dimer, implying that homodimerization regulates enzymatic activity in response to biotic and abiotic stresses.

pmc-11469993.title: Volume changes in the contralateral submandibular gland following unilateral gland excision in oral cancer patients
pmc-11469993.creator: Yei-Jin Kang, Young-Wook Park, Hang-Moon Choi, Seong-Gon Kim
pmc-11469993.description: BackgroundThe effects of unilateral submandibular gland excision on the size of the contralateral gland are not well understood, with no human studies reported to date. This study aims to investigate the impact of unilateral submandibular gland excision on the contralateral gland’s size, providing insights into compensatory mechanisms and their clinical implications.

pmc-11513205.title: Exploring the Association Between Clinical Characteristics and Etiopathogenesis of Tinnitus: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11513205.creator: Smriti Wadhwa, Shraddha Jain, Nimisha Patil, Harshil Dobariya, Vaibhavi Patil, Megha Kawale, Prasad T Deshmukh, Sagar S Gaurkar
pmc-11513205.description: Background Tinnitus is the perception of internal noises like ringing or hissing, which can greatly affect quality of life. It involves increased neuronal synchrony and interactions with non-auditory brain structures. There’s no universal classification system due to its varied origins and mechanisms, and current protocols often overlook physiotherapy, especially for non-otologic causes such as Cervicogenic and Temporomandibular disorders.

pmc-11607014.title: Synergizing Ecotoxicology and Microbiome Data Is Key for Developing Global Indicators of Environmental Antimicrobial Resistance
pmc-11607014.creator: John P. Makumbi, Samuel K. Leareng, Rian E. Pierneef, Thulani P. Makhalanyane
pmc-11607014.description: The One Health concept recognises the interconnectedness of humans, plants, animals and the environment. Recent research strongly supports the idea that the environment serves as a significant reservoir for antimicrobial resistance (AMR). However, the complexity of natural environments makes efforts at AMR public health risk assessment difficult.

pmc-12598571.title: Highlighting the Importance of His Bundle Potential During Tachycardia and Ventricular Overdrive Pacing
pmc-12598571.creator: Yasuharu Matsunaga‐Lee, Yasuyuki Egami, Koji Yasumoto, Masamichi Yano, Masami Nishino
pmc-12598571.description: Both AVNRT and NF‐ORT can be sustained with HV block. pmc-12630576.title: Physical exercise moderated the mediating role of anxiety between experiential avoidance and the teenagers BrainRot
pmc-12630576.creator: Jinyin Peng, Ziyuan Quan, Chuqi Yan, Junwei Dong, Zhiyu Chen, Pingfan Liu
pmc-12630576.description: This study aims to investigate the mediating role of anxiety in the relationship between experiential avoidance and BrainRot among teenagers, as well as the moderating effect of physical exercise on the relationship between experiential avoidance and anxiety. A cross-sectional study was conducted between February and March 2024 using convenience sampling from seven schools across five provinces in China.

pmc-12664810.title: Influence of pH, ion composition and carbohydrate recognition on the attachment of Cryptosporidium parvum to lamb’s lettuce

The disease poses significant health impacts, particularly to vulnerable populations such as young children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals, including those living with HIV/AIDS. Of the food-borne Cryptosporidium spp.

pmc-13059282.title: In silico analysis of stress distribution in ultra-translucent multilayered zirconia veneers of varying thickness and yttria content using Finite Element Analysis (FEA)
pmc-13059282.creator: Shivani Khandelwal, Devansh Verma, Anuj Bhardwaj, Surekha Puri Bhat, Shivani Bhardwaj, Suraj Arora, Dian Agustin Wahjuningrum, Ajinkya M Pawar
pmc-13059282.description: BackgroundThe clinical success of laminate veneer restorations largely relies on the mechanical properties of the materials used. With the rise of ultra-translucent multilayered zirconia, it is crucial to evaluate the impact of facial thickness and yttria content on fracture resistance.

pmc-13072331.title: Dual-Modal Chicken Mortality Detection Using Dynamic Hybrid Convolution-Based Feature Fusion
pmc-13072331.creator: Tian Hua, Qian Fan, Runhao Chen, Yulin Bi, Hao Bai, Zhixiu Wang, Guobin Chang, Wenming Zhao
pmc-13072331.description: Simple SummaryDeveloping non-contact methods for dead broiler detection using computer vision technology can help improve the efficiency and accuracy of daily inspection in large-scale broiler farming. At present, dead broiler detection in complex farming environments still faces challenges such as low light, occlusion, and background interference.

pmc-13213093.title: Safety and feasibility of transitioning from conventional burr-hole craniostomy to endoscope-assisted evacuation for chronic subdural hematoma: A retrospective cohort study
pmc-13213093.creator: Sing Soon Sam, Fu-Shan Jaw, Che-Kuang Lin, Tiing Foong Siow, Shyi Chun Yii, Yin-Jen Chang
pmc-13213093.description: ObjectiveAlthough endoscope-assisted evacuation for chronic subdural hematoma (cSDH) may reduce recurrence rates, its adoption has been limited by a procedural learning curve that may affect operative efficiency and clinical outcomes. This study compared conventional burr-hole craniostomy with endoscope-assisted evacuation for symptomatic cSDH and evaluated the challenges of institutional implementation.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed patients with symptomatic cSDH treated between 2023 and 2025.

pmc-13219392.title: Gender inequalities in high psychological distress vary across European regions and occupational subgroups
pmc-13219392.creator: Julia Grasshoff, Batoul Safieddine, Stefanie Sperlich, Johannes Beller
pmc-13219392.description: Gender inequalities in psychological distress have been found in various populations, including occupational groups and countries. There is a lack of studies that compare regions in a uniform operationalisation of distress and integrate occupational groups. 67,641 participants from 36 countries of the European Working Conditions Survey 2021 were analysed. High psychological distress was operationalized using the WHO-5 Well-Being Index.

pmc-13431932.title: Propofol‐induced hypertriglyceridemia in critically ill trauma patients requiring nutrition therapy: A descriptive cohort study
pmc-13431932.creator: Emma S. Lemke, Jonathon K. Walker, Julie E. Farrar, Saskya Byerly, Dina M. Filiberto, Roland N. Dickerson
pmc-13431932.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to assess the incidence and identify risk factors associated with the development of propofol‐induced hypertriglyceridemia in critically ill trauma patients who required nutrition therapy.MethodsAdult patients (aged >17 years) admitted to the trauma intensive care unit who received propofol for >24 h and had a serum triglyceride concentration determination during the infusion were retrospectively evaluated.

pmc-13575867.title: Population Status, Ecology and Conservation Challenges of Cattle Egrets (Bubulcus ibis), Especially in the Southern Africa Subregion: A Systematic Review and Evidence Synthesis
pmc-13575867.creator: Bhekinkosi Sibanda, Tawanda Tarakini, Josphine Mundava
pmc-13575867.description: The Cattle Egret ( Bubulcus ibis ) is one of Africa's most adaptable yet environmentally sensitive waterbirds, occupying natural wetlands, grazing systems, irrigated agro‐mosaics and urban green spaces. We conducted a systematic review of 173 studies published between the 1940s and 2025, incorporating global research where it provided insights relevant to Southern African populations.
